correctness.rationale: The full affine derivative is double centering, so each coefficient-row absolute sum is (2-2/9)^2=256/81. The seven permutations cover exactly the 38 entries, and their mean is bistochastic and positive on that support. A fresh exact recomputation gives rank 17 and det(BBᵀ)=810332352, so the displayed grounded-incidence formula is the orthogonal projection onto supported perturbations with all row and column sums zero (the omitted column sum is redundant). The (4,8) row has ℓ¹ norm 13394263/4220481, with excess 1497389/113952987. Using its sign as the direction makes the input denominator exactly the stated epsilon. At the second candidate the minimum supported entry is 703408248411/4923894500000 and the minimum off-support dual slack is 4220474028301/4220481000000, both positive. The residual is a row/column potential plus a nonpositive term supported off the face, so its inner product with any feasible displacement is nonpositive; the same argument with zero equality potential proves the first projection. The (4,8) quotient proves the lower bound without a global sharpness or minimum-order claim.
residual_risks: This checks one finite witness, not all order-nine faces or any smaller unclassified order.
